items.changed_constraint: 旧路径依赖完整上下文或简单相似度检索，短会话下可解释；长期、多租户与经验复用后，写入、遗忘、来源和冲突状态需要显式 owner。 论文暴露的具体压力是：Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems depend on the geometric properties of vector representations to retrieve contextually appropriate evidence.
items.state_control_owner: 作者公开的机制是：To address this, we introduce the Semantic Disentanglement Pipeline (SDP), a four-stage preprocessing framework that restructures documents prior to embedding. 对系统而言，控制权落在 write/read/evict/provenance policy。
items.tradeoffs_failure_fallback: 新 owner 是 memory write/read/evict/provenance policy；收益是跨步复用，代价是污染、陈旧、隐私泄露与错误迁移。置信度或 provenance 不足时回退当前上下文与只读证据。 本论文可定位的限制/压力为：We do not claim that entanglement fully explains RAG failure, but that it captures a distinct preprocessing failure mode that downstream optimization cannot reliably correct once encoded into the vector space.

items.title: Predictive Multi-Tier Memory Management for KV Cache in Large-Scale GPU Inference
items.existing_proposition: HBM 不足时，KV 与其他可预测状态不只在 GPU/host 间二选一，还可跨 host DRAM、CXL-hybrid memory 与 NVMe 形成 byte-addressable tier，并利用 model-weight 或 prefix access 的可预测性做 multi-tier DMA prefetch。另一条 I/O 分支把多 DRAM/SSD 汇成 bandwidth-weighted pool，以 user-space SPDK 避免单 host/filesystem 串行瓶颈。
items.evidence_delta: 作者公开的机制是：We present a unified system addressing all three. 对系统而言，控制权落在 cache page/token retention、compression/migration metadata 与 attention consistency。
items.claim_boundary: `Predictive Multi-Tier Memory Management for KV Cache in Large-Scale GPU Inference` 只证明 exact-v1 的公开模型、数据、硬件和 workload；evaluation evidence 为：Component-level validation on trace replay using ShareGPT, LMSYS-Chat-1M, and agentic workloads demonstrates 70-84% cache hit rates. Analytical projections combining validated component behavior with published hardware specifications indicate TTFT reductions of 1.4x to 2.1x, throughput improvements of 1.7x to 2.9x, and 47% cost reduction relative to published baselines; these cluster-scale projections are analytical and carry no error bars. 未披露生产 SLO、多租户、跨硬件或长期运行结果时，不得外推。
items.changed_constraint: 旧路径保存完整 attention history，语义直接且恢复简单；长上下文、并发或多层状态增长后，KV 容量与带宽成为主约束。 论文暴露的具体压力是：Key-value (KV) cache memory management is the primary bottleneck limiting throughput and cost-efficiency in large-scale GPU inference serving.
items.state_control_owner: 作者公开的机制是：We present a unified system addressing all three. 对系统而言，控制权落在 cache page/token retention、compression/migration metadata 与 attention consistency。
items.tradeoffs_failure_fallback: 新 owner 是 cache 保留/压缩/迁移策略及其与 attention 的一致性；收益以容量或带宽换取，代价是信息丢失、量化误差、控制元数据或额外重算。失败时应回退未压缩/更高精度 cache，并保留原路径的适用区间。 本论文可定位的限制/压力为：Key-value (KV) cache memory management is the primary bottleneck limiting throughput and cost-efficiency in large-scale GPU inference serving.
